# vs_temporalfix model architecture

`temporalfix_arch.py` is copied unchanged from **vs_temporalfix** by pifroggi (Apache-2.0),
commit `bc3d5d8b8bdf5ee3e785cc9a083fc6218dc91d63`:
https://github.com/pifroggi/vs_temporalfix/blob/bc3d5d8b8bdf5ee3e785cc9a083fc6218dc91d63/vs_temporalfix/models/temporalfix_arch.py

Its flow prediction and masking idea comes from RIFE (https://github.com/hzwer/ECCV2022-RIFE).
See `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt`. chaiNNer-C modifications: none (line endings normalized to LF). The model weights are separate
downloads (SHA-256 pinned in `nodes/impl/pytorch/temporal_fix.py`) and are not distributed here.
